findings.summary: The S5.6.7 tests do not check the main points of the table's Then. No test checks that the prompt names the copies' paths, that the disk row stands in a copy, or that the row's coai-question-* scratch is gone after each ending. The refused-row test does not set the unlink recorder. The answered row only checks that the granted root is absent from the prompt, so a prompt that names no path at all also passes.
findings.fix: Do what AVibeQuestionRowReadsACopyOfItsRootsTests.cs:124-126 does. Read the copy from request.WorkingDirectory, assert that StdIn contains it, and assert that the row's scratch folder does not exist after the answered, refused and cancelled endings. Also set GitScratch.AfterUnlink in AKimiDiskRow_RefusedBeforeTheLaunch_LeavesNothingBehind and assert that it was never called.

findings.fix: Change the diagram label so it does not give a count, or give the current count. Add the kimi rows and the planner arm to module_core.md. Add catalogue rows for the two new test classes to module_tests.md, with what each covers, the reds seen and what is not covered (the live rows and the live check owed to RESULTS §31).

findings.summary: Deviation 50 records that S5.5.1, S5.5.4, S5.6.7, S5.6.2 and S5.6.8 were never seen red. The epic's Definition of Done says every scenario must be watched red. When I read the code, S5.6.2 and S5.6.8 can fail by construction, but the path and disposal checks of S5.5.1, S5.5.4 and S5.6.7 have no recorded test that they can fail.
findings.fix: Break the code for a short time and watch each test go red: remove the Release(homes) call in QuestionRowLaunch, skip the junction-first disposal of <scratch>/own in ConsultCheckScratch, and remove the kimi vectors or the seed row. Record the red messages in deviation 50, then revert.
